description: JS port of gin_path_normalize_unicode Diamond: (1) add /v1/themes/:filename static endpoint with ../ sanitization, (2) add cross-platform normalization helper for upload, (3) apply filename.normalize('NFKC') on retrieval AFTER the ../ check. Fullwidth slash U+FF0F bypasses ASCII sanitizer, NFKC rewrites to / → traversal.
